title: Windows 10 Updates Are Ending
youtube_title: Windows 10 Security Updates Are Ending: What to Do Now | Fix It Friday
next: Next Friday: My Phone Battery Dies Too Fast
description: Still using a Windows 10 computer? Free security updates for home PCs end on October 13, 2026. Kip and Bub explain what that means, how to check if your computer can move to Windows 11 for free, and the scam pop-ups to ignore.

scenes.say: Still using a Windows 10 computer? On October 13th, 2026, free security updates for home computers end. Let's talk about what that means and what to do.
It's Fix It Friday. Today: Windows 10 updates are ending.
First, the good news. Your computer won't suddenly stop working. It will still turn on, open your files, and get online.
But security updates are the fixes that patch holes criminals use to break in. Without them, new holes stay open, and the computer gets riskier to use online every month.

card.text: No updates means new holes stay open.

scenes.say: Step one: check if your computer can move to Windows 11 for free. Open Settings, then Update and Security, then Windows Update. If it says your PC can run Windows 11, you can upgrade at no cost.
Before you upgrade, back up your photos and documents to a USB drive or the cloud. Upgrades usually keep your files, but a backup means you never have to worry.
If your computer can't run Windows 11, it may be time for a new one. A Windows 11 computer, a Mac, or a simple Chromebook will all keep getting updates. Use that time to plan, not panic.
And watch out. Scammers love news like this. A pop-up or phone call saying your Windows has expired and you must call a number right now is a scam. Microsoft will never call you out of the blue.

card.text: "Windows expired, call now" is a scam.

scenes.say: So: your computer keeps working, check if Windows 11 is free for you, back up first, plan a replacement if needed, and ignore scary pop-ups.
Got a tech problem you want fixed? Leave it in the comments, and it might be a future Fix It Friday. See you next Friday.
